Pick the CANONICAL one (most stars/activity/legit owner). PHASE B — ONLY IF a single clearly-canonical repo is identified, vet it:

   - Telemetry/phone-home: hardcoded URLs/IPs, analytics, requests.post to external hosts.
   - Model-weight/data auto-download: source + approx size; the user's box is 16GB RAM + RTX 5060 Ti — flag big VRAM needs or multi-GB downloads (compute/footprint risk).
   - Obfuscated/encoded blobs, pickled payloads, eval of downloaded content, cryptominer/high-compute background loops.
6. VERDICT: SAFE-TO-USE / SAFE-SOURCE-ONLY-DO-NOT-RUN / SKETCHY-DELETE, with file+line evidence for anything flagged. If SKETCHY-DELETE, delete the quarantine clone and say so. If SAFE, note usefulness for the user's work (neural-mesh/Hebbian-router R&D or the SaaS ventures) and whether to add to vetted-libraries.md (recommend only; don't edit that file).
7. WRITE the write-up (incl. the RESOLVED canonical URL you vetted) to `C:\Users\mariu\experiments\vet-agentic-diffusion.md`.
